history.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one standalone realistic Yuan northern-China map sprite. Original game reconstruction, not exact monument. Photoreal hand-made grey tile, buff earthen plaster, brown timber, stone; same restrained realistic detail density as Song map kit, no toy look. CRITICAL orthographic2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30; ground axes slopes+0.5/-0.5 precisely, all parallel edges remain parallel, verticals vertical, no perspective. Thin FLAT rectangular ground apron, visible LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT ground corners; no thick slab. Transparent RGBA background, whole object with 10% transparent margin, upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. No text, lettering, people, animals, signs, flags, UI, watermark, modern objects, sky, scenery, checkerboard, Qing architecture, elaborate gold dragons. Subject: one NORTHERN YUAN DAOIST TEMPLE HALL14x11m, adapted from Yongle Palace Yuan timber heritage rather than precise reconstruction. Very broad shallow-pitch SINGLE-EAVE HIP ROOF with NO triangular exposed gable; heavy gray tube tiles and restrained muted green/blue glazed ridge-end ornaments, deep timber eaves, robust sparse bracket clusters, red-brown columns, thick earth plaster side wall above gray brick skirt, five plain timber lattice doors,3 low stone steps all inside thin rectangle footprint. Doorway is dark, NO Buddha statue or figures. Modest blue-green beam decoration, no modern Qing gold paintings. Match reference realism but replace its tall gabled roof with four-sided shallow HIP roof and keep stone base ratio14:11. Both ground diagonals must be26.565degrees, slopes+0.5/-0.5, no big perspective or thick plinth.
